verification_policy.canonical_rule: Only publish a repair fact when the cited source supports the fact and its vehicle applicability. Missing detail remains missing rather than inferred.
verification_policy.computer_boundary_message: PartGraph does not support vehicle-computer diagnostics, relearn, coding, programming, calibration, or service-tool operations.

actions.title: Warm engine and shut it down
actions.instruction: Bring the engine to normal operating temperature, shut it off, open the hood, and remove the engine-oil fill cap.

actions.title: Open underbody access
actions.instruction: On U.S. models, remove the nine holding clips and two bolts and lower the undercover.

actions.title: Drain the engine oil
actions.instruction: Remove the drain bolt and washer and drain the oil into an appropriate container.

actions.title: Remove the oil filter
actions.instruction: Remove the oil filter, let the remaining oil drain, and make sure the old filter gasket is not stuck to the engine block.

actions.title: Install filter and drain bolt
actions.instruction: Install the new filter according to its instructions. Fit a new washer to the drain bolt, reinstall it, and tighten the drain bolt to 29 lbf-ft (39 N-m).

actions.title: Refill engine oil
actions.instruction: Refill with 3.4 US qt (3.2 L) of the recommended engine oil and reinstall the fill cap.

actions.title: Check pressure, leaks, and final level
actions.instruction: Start the engine. The oil-pressure indicator should go out within 5 seconds. Let the engine run several minutes, check the drain bolt and filter for leaks, then shut down, wait several minutes, and confirm the dipstick level.

actions.title: Reinstall the undercover
actions.instruction: Reinstall the undercover, two bolts, and nine holding clips; lock each clip by pushing its center.

actions.title: Switch the vehicle off
actions.instruction: Turn the engine switch off.

actions.title: Open the glove box access
actions.instruction: Open the glove box and remove the glove-box cover inside the glove box.

actions.title: Remove the filter cover
actions.instruction: Remove the air-conditioning filter cover.

actions.title: Replace the filter
actions.instruction: Remove the old filter and install the new filter with the UP marks pointing upward.

actions.title: Restore the glove box
actions.instruction: Reinstall the filter cover and glove-box cover.

actions.title: Release air-cleaner case
actions.instruction: Unsnap the two clips holding the front of the air-cleaner case.

actions.title: Remove the old element
actions.instruction: Open the rear portion of the air-cleaner case and remove the air-cleaner element.

actions.title: Clean the housing
actions.instruction: Clean the inside of the front and rear air-cleaner case with a damp cloth.

actions.title: Install the new element
actions.instruction: Install the new air-cleaner element, insert the three rear-case projections into the front-case slits, and reinstall in reverse order.

repairs.title: Replace front brake pads and rotors
repairs.applicability: 2014-2018 Subaru Forester front disc brakes; reference vehicle 2018 2.5i

requirements.name: Caliper piston compressor or suitable clamp

actions.title: Secure and support the vehicle
actions.instruction: Park on a level surface, secure the vehicle against movement, loosen the front wheel fasteners on the ground, raise the front, and support it on jack stands.

actions.title: Remove the front wheel
actions.instruction: Remove the wheel to expose the front brake caliper, bracket, and rotor.

actions.title: Remove caliper and pads
actions.instruction: Remove the 14 mm caliper fasteners, move the caliper aside without stressing the brake hose, and remove the old pads.

actions.title: Remove bracket and rotor
actions.instruction: Remove the caliper bracket fasteners and remove the rotor. If fitted, remove the rotor retaining screws before pulling the rotor from the hub.

actions.title: Prepare the brake hardware
actions.instruction: Clean the hub and new rotor, service the caliper slides with brake-compatible grease, and compress the caliper piston enough for the new pad thickness.

actions.title: Install rotor, pads, and caliper
actions.instruction: Install the cleaned rotor, bracket, new pads, and caliper. Start fasteners by hand and tighten them to the applicable verified torque values before the vehicle is returned to service.

actions.title: Reinstall the wheel
actions.instruction: Reinstall the wheel, lower the vehicle safely, and tighten the wheel fasteners to the applicable verified wheel torque.

actions.title: Restore pedal before moving
actions.instruction: Pump the brake pedal repeatedly until it is firm before attempting to move the vehicle.

actions.title: Perform low-speed brake test
actions.instruction: Verify braking at very low speed before a normal road test. Stop if pedal feel or braking behavior is abnormal.

notes: Opening the hydraulic circuit is not part of this definition. If hydraulic bleeding becomes necessary, it must be selected as a separate physical bleeding procedure with its own verified evidence.

repairs.title: Replace halogen headlamp bulb
repairs.applicability: 2020 Hyundai Tucson with halogen headlamp configuration

actions.title: Cool and secure the vehicle
actions.instruction: Turn the vehicle off, allow the headlamp bulb to cool, open the hood, and keep the vehicle secured against movement.

actions.title: Disconnect 12-volt negative battery cable
actions.instruction: Disconnect the negative battery cable before opening the headlamp bulb circuit.

actions.title: Open headlamp bulb access
actions.instruction: Turn the headlamp bulb cover counterclockwise and remove it, then disconnect the bulb socket connector.

actions.title: Remove the bulb
actions.instruction: Release the retaining wire and remove the bulb. Do not touch the glass of the replacement halogen bulb with bare fingers.

actions.title: Install the replacement bulb
actions.instruction: Install the new bulb, seat and secure the retaining wire, reconnect the socket connector, and reinstall the bulb cover clockwise.

actions.title: Reconnect and test
actions.instruction: Reconnect the 12-volt negative battery cable and verify the replacement lamp illuminates normally.

notes: Headlamp assembly aiming is deliberately outside this MVP. This definition is only for bulb replacement where the assembly itself is not removed or disturbed.

actions.title: Open the air cleaner
actions.instruction: Release the air-cleaner cover and move its locking levers to the unlocked position.

actions.title: Replace the filter
actions.instruction: Remove the old filter without allowing dirt into the intake and install the replacement filter.

actions.title: Secure the housing
actions.instruction: Reassemble the air-cleaner housing and confirm the cover is firmly installed before running the engine.

repairs.title: Replace rear shock absorbers
repairs.applicability: 2017 Toyota Tacoma SR5; exact OE suspension configuration still requires final source confirmation before guided publication
notes: Kept candidate because the Toyota accessory instruction is TRD Pro-specific while the reference vehicle is SR5. PartGraph must not infer exact SR5 procedure from shared generation layout.

repairs.title: Replace radiator and physically bleed cooling system
repairs.applicability: 2009 Honda Civic Hybrid; exact Hybrid removal procedure not yet sufficiently corroborated
notes: The radiator OEM part number and coolant are verified for the Hybrid. The guided removal/install procedure remains unpublished until Hybrid-specific applicability is established; no 1.8L procedure is silently promoted to Hybrid truth.
